args.text: CREATE TABLE DG (d LONG CONSTRAINT PK_DG PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE NUM (n LONG CONSTRAINT PK_NUM PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO NUM (n) SELECT a.d * 64 + b.d * 8 + c.d + 1 FROM DG AS a, DG AS b, DG AS c ORDER BY a.d, b.d, c.d
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM NUM
CREATE TABLE OT5 (pk LONG, k LONG, ins LONG, s TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE OT2 (pk LONG CONSTRAINT PK_OT2 PRIMARY KEY, k LONG, ins LONG, s TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE OT3 (pk LONG CONSTRAINT PK_OT3 PRIMARY KEY, k LONG, ins LONG, s TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE OT4 (pk LONG CONSTRAINT PK_OT4 PRIMARY KEY, k LONG, ins LONG, s TEXT(10))
CREATE INDEX IX_OT4_KI ON OT4 (k, ins DESC)
INSERT INTO OT5 (pk, k, ins, s) SELECT 1000 - n, n Mod 7, n, 't' & (n Mod 5) FROM NUM WHERE n <= 256 ORDER BY n
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM OT5
INSERT INTO OT2 (pk, k, ins, s) SELECT 1000 - n, n Mod 7, n, 't' & (n Mod 5) FROM NUM WHERE n <= 256 ORDER BY n
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM OT2
INSERT INTO OT3 (pk, k, ins, s) SELECT 1000 - n, n Mod 7, n, 't' & (n Mod 5) FROM NUM WHERE n <= 256 ORDER BY n
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM OT3
INSERT INTO OT4 (pk, k, ins, s) SELECT 1000 - n, n Mod 7, n, 't' & (n Mod 5) FROM NUM WHERE n <= 256 ORDER BY n
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM OT4
CREATE TABLE UA (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_UA PRIMARY KEY, v LONG)
CREATE TABLE UB (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_UB PRIMARY KEY, v LONG)
CREATE TABLE UC (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_UC PRIMARY KEY, v LONG)
INSERT INTO UA (id, v) SELECT n, 21 - n FROM NUM WHERE n <= 20 ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO UB (id, v) SELECT n, n + 10 FROM NUM WHERE n <= 20 ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO UC (id, v) SELECT n, (n * 7) Mod 23 FROM NUM WHERE n <= 20 ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE JL (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_JL PRIMARY KEY, k LONG)
CREATE TABLE JLI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_JLI PRIMARY KEY, k LONG)
CREATE TABLE JR (rid LONG CONSTRAINT PK_JR PRIMARY KEY, k LONG, ins LONG)
CREATE TABLE JRI (rid LONG CONSTRAINT PK_JRI PRIMARY KEY, k LONG, ins LONG)
INSERT INTO JL (id, k) SELECT n, n Mod 5 FROM NUM WHERE n <= 16 ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO JLI (id, k) SELECT n, n Mod 5 FROM NUM WHERE n <= 16 ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO JR (rid, k, ins) SELECT 100 - n, n Mod 4, n FROM NUM WHERE n <= 32 ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO JRI (rid, k, ins) SELECT 100 - n, n Mod 4, n FROM NUM WHERE n <= 32 ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE OG (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_OG PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT(10), n LONG)
CREATE TABLE OGI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_OGI PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT(10), n LONG)
SELECT k, Count(*) AS n FROM OT5 GROUP BY k
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM UA
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM JL
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM JR
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM OGI
